changelog:
- Expanded and reorganized documentation to clarify credential, config path, and external connection requirements.
- Added detailed tables summarizing required credentials, storage locations, privacy policy, and external services used.
- Included a manifest summary section for transparent disclosure of all runtime secrets and config paths.
- Improved consistency in documentation links and contact information.
- No changes to plugin logic or code in this release (documentation update only).
display_name: Claw Messenger - iMessage without a Mac
summary: Enables OpenClaw agents to send and receive iMessage, RCS, and SMS without a phone or Mac by connecting via a secure WebSocket relay server.
